mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM file f WHERE (f.biz_type NOT IN (#{problemAttachment}, #{contestAttachment}, #{testData}) OR (f.biz_type IN (#{problemAttachment}, #{testData}) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM problem p WHERE p.id = f.biz_id AND (#{scope.administrator} = TRUE OR (#{scope.problemManager} = TRUE AND p.author_id = #{scope.userId})))) OR (f.biz_type = #{contestAttachment} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contest c WHERE c.id = f.biz_id AND (#{scope.administrator} = TRUE OR (#{scope.contestManager} = TRUE AND c.creator_id = #{scope.userId}))))) AND ((#{scope.generalFiles} = TRUE AND (f.biz_type != #{testData}) AND (#{scope.privateFiles} = TRUE OR f.biz_type = #{general})) OR (#{scope.testData} = TRUE AND f.biz_type = #{testData})) AND f.original_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.fileName}, '%') AND f.biz_type = #{query.bizType} AND f.service = #{query.storageKey} ORDER BY f.id DESC
